dedupe_keys.name: ihme global health spending 1995 2022 health spending by source for 204 countries and territories

description: This dataset gives retrospective estimates of health spending from 1995 to 2022 for 204 countries and territories, produced by the Global Burden of Disease Health Financing Collaborator Network at the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation and catalogued in the Global Health Data Exchange with a DOI. Estimates cover total health spending and spending by source: government, out-of-pocket, prepaid private and development assistance for health. Domestic spending draws mainly on the WHO Global Health Expenditure Database, and development assistance on programme reports, budgets, national estimates and National Health Accounts. Values are reported in constant 2023 US dollars, purchasing power parity dollars and as a share of gross domestic product. The data are free to download as CSV with a codebook and information sheet, released in July 2025, for non-commercial use under the IHME free-of-charge non-commercial user agreement. Caveats: figures are modelled estimates with uncertainty, commercial use needs permission, and newer releases supersede this one. Simulation uses: setting health system financing baselines for resilience and recovery analyses, weighting countries by health spending capacity in cross-country hazard studies, and appraising investment needs. Related records: the WHO Global Health Expenditure Database (data-who-global-health-expenditure-database) is the main input and the GHDx (data-ghdx-global-health-data-exchange) catalogues related IHME data.
